text:
maria: quick check — I'm about to merge a terraform plan that moves a few secrets under a new path for staging->prod promotion. Anyone see immediate issues with k8s overlays or the release gating config? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4828

aj: can you paste the plan diff for the secretsmanager resources? quick eyeball.

maria: sure — snippet from the plan:
```
-/aws_secretsmanager_secret.secret_app_db (forces new resource)
+resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "secret_app_db" {
+  name = "redwood/staging/app-db/creds-v2"
}
```

maria: summary: old path `redwood/staging/app-db/creds` -> new `.../creds-v2`. There are two other service secrets in the same PR.

devon: heads up — the release gating in deployer-service (releases/config.yaml) still references the old path for canary traffic validation. If we merge this without updating that, promote will fail the validation step.

leo: also check kustomize overlays for the staging namespace. I remember we have a `secretGenerator` entry that references the literal path in a patch.

aj: @maria can you add a kustomize patch like this to infra/kustomize/staging/overlays/secrets-patch.yaml so the overlay keeps working?
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
patchesJson6902:
- target:
    group: ""
    version: v1
    kind: Secret
    name: app-db-creds
  patch: |
    - op: replace
      path: /data/path
      value: redwood/staging/app-db/creds-v2
```

maria: added that patch to the PR (last commit). Also updated infra/terraform/modules/secrets/README with migration notes.

sre-elena: what about IAM? Will services reading the secret need new kms/iam permissions for the new ARN?

maria: the underlying secret resource is still the same account/region, just name change — the ARN changes. I included a terraform change that updates the aws_secretsmanager_secret_policy to reference the new ARN. Should be fine, but worth a quick IAM approval.

sam: I can run a quick smoke: apply in staging (non-prod) and run the promote validation locally. Give me 15m window.

infra-bot: CI: terraform validate passed on PR #4828. plan size: 3 to add, 0 to destroy, 0 to change. (note: this is a summary from the infra CI).

aj: one more nit — bump the chart version in deployments/app/Chart.yaml to avoid helm reconciliation mismatch during canary.

maria: done. bumped to 1.4.9. Also added a note in the release gating runbook on how to rollback the secret name if promote fails.

devon: sounds good. two asks before merge: (1) update releases/config.yaml gating path to `redwood/staging/app-db/creds-v2` (I can submit a tiny PR there), (2) confirm SRE smoke passed.

sam: smoke completed — app can fetch secrets and start fine. I hit no IAM deny.

leo: approved from kustomize side. small comment about using `patchesStrategicMerge` instead of json6902 for readability, but not blocking.

aj: LGTM. merging once deployer gating PR is queued. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — merging in 5m. I'll watch the promo window and post status.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging apply queued at 1755559950.

maria: posting follow-up in #incidents if anything breaks during promote.

sam: thanks — will keep an eye.
